title: FULLSCREEN GATE SCALES LIKE THE MENUS
why: The 4K pictures of v35.02 showed the fullscreen gate at half the size of the pause menu: it sits outside the windows the menu screen factor reaches. It now takes the same factor, and follows a resize while it is up.
now: The fullscreen gate is the same size as the menus at 4K.

edits.replacement:
if(on!==FSG.was){ FSG.was=on; try{ fsPauseBtnSync(); }catch(_pb){} }
  if(FSG.open){ try{ fsGateZoom(); }catch(_gz){} }   // v16.xx (cw-fsgatezoom): a resize while the gate is up
